headline: Bahrain says won't participate in Hormuz meeting with Iran
summary: Bahrain said it will not participate in the proposed Oman meeting between Iran and Gulf states on the Strait of Hormuz, arguing regional security cannot be preserved through appeasement and calling for the strait to be open without discrimination, fees or permits. This is a substantive negative development versus the previously covered diplomatic framework because it reduces the breadth and credibility of the planned talks, while the meeting itself has not been cancelled.
